select from wf_collaboration_outbox
order by create_time desc,message_id desc limit #{pageSize} offset #{offset}
select from wf_collaboration_outbox where message_id=#{messageId} for update

select from wf_collaboration_outbox current_message where current_message.status in ('PENDING','RETRYING','DELIVERING') and current_message.next_attempt_time <= current_timestamp(3) and (current_message.status <> 'DELIVERING' or current_message.lease_until <= current_timestamp(3)) and not exists ( select 1 from wf_collaboration_outbox previous_message where previous_message.channel_id=current_message.channel_id and previous_message.sequence_no < current_message.sequence_no and previous_message.status not in ('PROCESSED','CANCELLED') ) order by current_message.next_attempt_time,current_message.create_time,current_message.message_id limit 1 for update skip locked
mapper.update: update wf_collaboration_outbox set attempt_count=attempt_count+1, status='DELIVERING',lease_owner=#{leaseOwner}, lease_until=date_add(current_timestamp(3),interval #{leaseSeconds} second), last_attempt_time=current_timestamp(3),revision_no=revision_no+1 where message_id=#{messageId} and revision_no=#{expectedRevision} and ((status in ('PENDING','RETRYING') and attempt_count < max_attempts) or (status='DELIVERING' and lease_until <= current_timestamp(3)))

update wf_collaboration_outbox set status=#{targetStatus},last_http_status=#{httpStatus},last_error_code=#{errorCode}, last_error_summary=#{errorSummary},lease_owner=null,lease_until=null, next_attempt_time=date_add(current_timestamp(3),interval #{delaySeconds} second), complete_time=case when #{targetStatus}='DEAD_LETTER' then current_timestamp(3) else null end, revision_no=revision_no+1 where message_id=#{messageId} and status='DELIVERING' and lease_owner=#{leaseOwner} and revision_no=#{expectedRevision}

update wf_collaboration_outbox set status='RETRYING',attempt_count=0,compensation_count=compensation_count+1, lease_owner=null,lease_until=null,next_attempt_time=current_timestamp(3),complete_time=null, last_error_code=null,last_error_summary=null,revision_no=revision_no+1 where message_id=#{messageId} and status='DEAD_LETTER' and revision_no=#{expectedRevision}

update wf_collaboration_outbox set status='CANCELLED',lease_owner=null,lease_until=null,complete_time=current_timestamp(3), revision_no=revision_no+1 where message_id=#{messageId} and (status in ('PENDING','RETRYING','DEAD_LETTER') or (status='DELIVERING' and lease_until <= current_timestamp(3))) and revision_no=#{expectedRevision}
mapper.delete: delete from wf_collaboration_message_audit where direction='OUTBOUND' and message_id in #{messageId}
mapper.select: select min(complete_time) from wf_collaboration_outbox where status in ('PROCESSED','CANCELLED') and complete_time is not null
